landing.title: A distinctive scholarly programme that makes structured reading achievable
landing.body: Himam, from the Murtaqi Scientific Association: carefully chosen books, an ordered reading plan, and a short quiz after every section — with certificates, badges and an honour board that track your progress as you go.

one.title: A distinctive programme
one.body: A scholarly programme built to make structured reading achievable.

two.title: Carefully chosen books
two.body: Content drawn from the great books and trusted scholarly sources.

three.title: Building awareness and thought
three.body: An enjoyable journey that builds intellectual skill and deepens understanding.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.body: Welcome screens giving a short account of what the programme is for and what it sets out to do.

auth.loginBody: Sign in with your Murtaqi Institute account details.
auth.loginHint: If you don't have an account yet, create one through the Murtaqi Institute site and then return here.
auth.registerBody: A new account gives you access to Himam and to the Murtaqi Association.
auth.name: Name
auth.invalid: Those credentials don't match our records.
auth.nameHint: As it should appear on your certificate.
auth.acceptsEmail: I agree to receive emails from Murtaqi Institute.
auth.emailNotice: Please give a working email address so the programme’s messages reach you.
auth.forgotBody: Enter the email address on your account and we will send you a link to set a new password.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been reset. You can sign in now.
auth.resetLinkMissing: This page needs the link from your reset email. Please open that link, or ask for a new one.

home.subtitle: Keep going — you are moving towards the goal.
home.honorNote: A friendly competition honouring the readers who work hardest across the levels and books, ranked monthly or yearly as the programme administration decides.

progress.title: My progress
progress.body: A detailed view of your journey through the programme: the sections, books and levels you have finished, the badges you are closest to, and your recent attempts.
progress.noActivity: No attempts yet — start with your first section.
progress.allDone: You have finished every available section.

books.title: Books
books.body: Content drawn from the great books and trusted scholarly sources, divided into short sections, each followed by a brief quiz that settles what you have read.

quiz.title: Section quiz
quiz.passedNote: The section's points have been added to your balance.
quiz.failedNote: Review the section, then try again.
quiz.answerAll: Please answer every question before submitting.
quiz.empty: This section has no questions yet.

badges.title: Badges
badges.body: The badges and honours you have earned, shown alongside the ones still locked — an encouragement to keep reading.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.body: Every verified certificate you have earned on finishing a programme, with the certificates available at each level.
certificates.empty: No certificates yet — finish every section of a level and yours will be issued.

honor.title: Honour board
honor.body: A friendly competition honouring the readers who work hardest across the levels and books, ranked monthly or yearly as the programme administration decides.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Your notice board: new reading programmes as they open, exam dates and results, and updates to the honour board and certificates — whether announced to everyone or sent to you alone.

account.title: Account
account.note: Further settings and information as the programme adds them.

admin.title: Admin
admin.translationHint: One language is enough; the fallback language is used wherever a translation is missing.
admin.confirmDelete: Delete this? The action cannot be undone.

locales.help: Add or disable a language without adding any new fields.
locales.codeHelp: ISO code, e.g. tr or pt-BR
locales.nameHelp: The name in its own language
locales.defaultLocked: The default language cannot be deleted
locales.note: A new language is immediately available on every content field. Interface text falls back to the default language until a translation bundle is added to the project.

login.title: Sign in to reach the dashboard
login.notAdmin: That account is not an administrator. Use your admin credentials.

admin.pagesHint: The About and Privacy screens. A new slug becomes a new page — no deploy needed.
admin.slugHint: Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens. The app reads the page at /api/pages/<slug>.
admin.contactHint: Shown on the contact and support screen.
admin.orderMatters: Order decides what unlocks next. Book 1 is open; each one after it waits on the one before.
admin.selectiveHint: Only the readers ticked here can see this program. It is hidden from everyone else.
admin.programsHint: Reading programs: open to all, unlocked in order, or assigned to chosen readers.

programs.title: Reading programs

typeHints.general: Visible to everyone. Books can be read in any order.
typeHints.sequential: Each book unlocks only once the previous one is finished.
typeHints.selective: Visible only to the readers you assign. Hidden from everyone else.

programs.empty: No programs are available to you yet.
programs.lead: Choose a path and read it through. Some are open to all, some unlock book by book.
